title: sverify report
description: A report as Report.to_json writes it and Report.from_json reads it (#736). Format 1. Within 1.x the format only gains optional keys, values from a fixed set may gain new values, and readers ignore keys they do not know (docs/stability.md). Conditions appear as their labels, the text str(report) prints.

sverify.description: The version of sverify that wrote the report.

proved.description: Report.proved: every postcondition holds, no runtime error is possible, and nothing more is needed.

verdict.description: The report's first line: "proved", or "NOT proved: " and what is missing, counted.

semantics.description: The profile the report is under. 1.x may add values.

dialect.description: The language of the transformation, which the labels and code are written in.

on_inferred.description: What the inferred preconditions do to the proof (verify(on_inferred=...)).

deterministic.description: Whether the result is determined up to row order (Report.deterministic).

rows.description: At most this many output rows; null if nothing bounds them.

params.description: The ibis.param values the transformation was verified with, as `name (type) = value`.

requires.description: The preconditions assumed, as labels, per input table: the declared ones and those inferred.

inferred.description: The bounds sverify inferred, per input table.

ensures.description: Each postcondition, in the order given.

issues.description: The runtime errors the checker could not rule out.

assumed.description: The SUMs assumed to fit their type and the double operations assumed to stay finite, each checked on the data while the job runs.

needs.description: The preconditions the proof needs that requires does not state (Report.needs); empty unless on_inferred is "error".

facts.description: What the checker established about each output column, in words.

output.description: The output's columns with their Ibis types.

routes.description: The route each engine ran the plan by, by engine name; empty until the report's plan runs.

tie_places.description: Where the plan leaves the order of ties open.

ties.description: The sv.unique(...) per input table that would determine a result with ties.

rewrites.description: The rewrites of the optimized plan.

implied.description: A SQL condition per input table that every row reaching the result passes.

transfer.description: Under semantics="substrait", the options where the reference's proof does not carry over; null under the other profiles.

floats_on.description: Per engine, why its doubles may not meet the observation (empty where they do).

observation.description: What the result's consumer observes (sv.equivalent): its text and its components; a tolerance on doubles is {abs, rel, ulps}.

value.description: What the checker established about the condition, such as "TRUE or NULL".

reason.description: CheckedCondition.reason: why it is not proved, as a code; null when it is proved and independent of the observation. 1.x may add values.

message.description: Its status in words, as str(report) prints it.

checked.description: Checked on the output data instead (on_unproved="runtime").

counterexample.description: Inputs that meet the preconditions on which the condition fails. Values are JSON's own; NaN, infinities, decimals, dates, times and bytes (as hex) are text.

shown.description: The operation in the user's terms.

message.description: The issue in words, as str(report) prints it.

value.description: The bound as a SQL literal.

code.description: The condition as the Python a user writes in requires.

kind.description: The route taken; null for a refusal. 1.x may add values.

class.description: The plan's class on the engine. 1.x may add values.
